k. Utilities
(1) City Utilities
The utilities provided by the City (water, sewer service; see appendix E), will not be impacted due to the absence of any scheduled subsurface activity.
The utility systems could have an impact on project redevelopment and the street and sidewalk improvements to be made as part of the plan.
The age of the water main and the resultant discoloration of the water in areas of the project (see Part II, paragraph 6) could make residential redevelopment less attractive to potential developers.
The danger of latent sewer failure and water main failure, given the age and condition of the systems, is a threat to the street and sidewalk improvement scheduled under the plan for the area. Should the systems fail, over the next few years, some of the streets repaired, at project expense, would be excavated and require reconstruction; thus wasting the benefits to the area as provided by the project activity. This, therefore, is a major negative consideration.
(2) Other Utilities
Other utilities in the area, (electricity, gas and telephone) will be little effected by the project. There is the possibility that during redevelopment of the property along Front Street, the gas and water mains and the sewers will have to be tapped. This may cause some disruption to the street surface. Likewise, the overhead electrical systems may have to be revised
